scope: Original-dimensional M=10/K=2 reduced Monte Carlo slice of v2 Fig3 and Figs5-8; not full reproduction
paired: The same H is shared across both methods and every Gamma for each trial; same original power/noise/aperture/grid objective
infeasibility: Retain exact solver status and residual certificate, never discard or replace with feasible output. A solver infeasible result is distinct from a hand-proved impossibility.
aggregate_policy: Report all statuses and accepted counts. Performance averages use paired accepted cases only with denominator shown; feasibility and numerical-rejection counts always use all 32 trials. No interpolation over failed/infeasible cases.
open: N=1024 QPSK transmitted block and finite-sample covariance
Original author seeds and CVX solver tolerances unknown
